senses.gloss:
स्पृ स्पृ, † स्तृ स्तृ, † स्मृ स्मृ, ii. 5, Par.
 1. † To gratify.
 2. To protect.
 3. † To live.
† स्पॄ स्पॄ, ii. 9, स्पृणा, णी, Par. To hurt, to kill.

1. स्पृश् स्पृश्, i. 6, Par. (in epic poetry also Ātm.),
 1. To touch, Rām. 2, 42, 6; 3, 53, 47; with अद्भिस्, To sprinkle with water, Man. 2, 60; with हस्तम् अन्योन्यम्, To shake hands with each other, Vikr. 11, 14.
 2. To reach, to attain, Lass. 2. ed. 78, 72.
 3. Pass. To be seized, Daśak. in Chr. 194, 5 (by inebriation or frenzy).
 4. To obtain, to undergo, MBh. 3, 318. स्पृष्ट,
 1. Touched, Bhartṛ. 2, 36.
 2. Felt.
 3. Defiled, Lass. 2. ed. 67, 31.
 --Comp.
 --Comp. ptcple. of the fut pass. अ-स्पृश्य, not to be touched, Rājat. 5, 401.
 --Caus.
 1. To order to touch, Man. 8, 114.
 2. To give, Man. 11, 135.
 --With अप अप, in अपो पस्पृश्य, MBh. 1, 764, To touch water for ablution, i. e. to rinse one's mouth, is probably preserved as an archaism for अप उपस्पृश्य, see उप-स्पृश्.
 --With उप उप,
 1. To [] couch, Chr. 36, 14; दन्तईस् दन्तान्, To gnash the teeth, Nal. 7, 3; with and without अद्भिस्, To sprinkle with water, Man. 4, 143; 5, 138.
 2. To rinse one's mouth (as ablution), Man. 2, 53.
 3. To bathe, Man. 5, 62.
 --With पर्युप परि-उप, To touch or to use for ablution, MBh. 3, 165.
 --With समुप सम्-उप,
 1. The same, MBh. 3, 8022.
 2. To bathe, MBh. 3, 10530.
 --With परि परि, To touch, Rām. 1, 9, 38.
 --With सम् सम्,
 1. To touch, Man. 3, 178; with अद्भिस्, To sprinkle with water, Man. 2, 53.
 2. To perceive, Rājat. 5, 375. संस्पृष्ट, Touched, Hit. ii. d. 16.
 --With अभिसम् अभि-सम्, To bathe, MBh. 3, 8080.
 --With परिसम् परि-सम्, To touch, to stroke, MBh. 3, 1457.

2. स्पृश् स्पृश्, adj. Who or what touches, touching, Rājat. 5, 343; 475 (having).
 --Comp.

स्पृश स्पृश् + अ, erroneous reading, Man. 8, 116 (see स्पश).
 --Comp.
स्पृष्टि स्पृष्टि, i. e. स्पृश् + ति, f. Touch, feeling.
स्पृष्टिन् स्पृष्टिन्, i. e. स्पृष्ट (vb. स्पृश्), + इन्, adj. One who has touched, Man. 5, 85.

स्पृह् स्पृह्, i. 10, स्पृहय (old Caus. of स्पर्ध्, with ह् for ध्, and ऋ for अर्), Par., with dat. and gen.
 1. To envy, Pañc. 137, 16.
 2. To desire, to [] long for, Rām. 3, 53, 39; Śāk. 103, 4.
 --Cf. probably Lat. spero, spes; O.H.G. spulgen.
स्पृहणीयता स्पृहणीय + ता (vb. स्पृह्), f. Condition of being worthy to be desired, Utt. Rāmac. 160, 3.
स्पृहणीयत्व स्पृहणीय + त्व (vb. स्पृह्), n. Enviableness, Rājat. 5, 336.

स्पृहा स्पृह् + आ, f. Wish, desire, Hit. ii. d. 121; Pañc. 131, 19 (read स्पृहां).
 --Comp.
